# matrix_units_golden.txt — every unit test/e2e/all_phases_test.go declares, as the parallel runner
# parses it: matrix|pkg|tags|race|run|extra, plus one `<whole>|lit=` line per package pattern / -run value /

#   new unit          -> go test ./test/e2e/parallel/ -run TestMatrixUnitInventoryOnlyGrows -update-matrix-inventory
#   removed / changed -> hand-edit the line and say why in the commit message. Deleting a glob in
#                        all_phases_test.go is silent everywhere else (its own B5 note); here it is red.
